ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); advise the driver that pressing "I'm Here" and waiting at the pickup point for more than 3 minutes is required before a rider no-show cancellation fee can be charged.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's claim of a rider no-show fails NS-1(iii): the GPS trace and timeline show only ~1 min 50 s (2 min 30 s from arrival) at the pickup point, short of the >3-minute requirement, so the $6.61 fee cannot stand (NS-2).
